prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Children’s educational story illustration matching the reference: warm light watercolor and colored pencil on fine cream paper, soft hand-drawn contours, sunlit muted pastel palette, rounded natural proportions. Same cute East Asian child, short dark brown hair, orange-red short sleeve shirt, blue trousers. Concrete unambiguous actions for preschoolers. No text, letters, captions, numerals, arrows, icons, watermarks or decorative frames. Asset: EXACT regular 3 columns by 2 rows action-card atlas, landscape 3:2 canvas, six equally sized SQUARE cells, edge-to-edge strict grid, no gutters, no borders, cream-white backgrounds. Each cell independent, all subjects fully contained with 8% margin, no overlapping across cells. Same child and same blocks/low table/box. Row 1 left FALLEN: blocks scattered on floor, child stands hands empty, table empty. Row 1 middle PICK: child bends down, one hand taking a floor block, other hand placing a block onto low table; other loose blocks still on floor; no tower. Row 1 right TOWER: colorful blocks make one clear tall tower on low table, floor clear, child smiles hands empty. Row 2 left BUILD TOO SOON: child places one block onto a very short two-block stack on low table, while MOST other blocks visibly still scattered on floor; show both tabletop attempt and floor mess. Row 2 middle BOX: child puts blocks into an open storage box, NO tower anywhere, some blocks already inside box, table empty. Row 2 right entirely BLANK cream-white. No text, panel labels, sequence arrows, ticks or crosses. Actions must be concrete and obvious at small size.
review: 通过：散落、捡到桌上、桌面高塔、地面未收齐就搭塔、装盒无塔；末格空白。
